name: HVAC and Refrigeration
summary:
HVAC and Refrigeration is an immersive Virtual Reality training application designed to provide hands-on learning for technicians in a safe, controlled environment. Through realistic simulations, users can explore key concepts, practice system operations, and develop critical troubleshooting skills essential to the HVAC and refrigeration industry.

This application is exclusively part of the Immerse Learn HVAC and Refrigeration micro-credential program. Access is limited to learners who are officially enrol
